_meta.description: Heart event #6 for npc_leera: Under the Stars

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The Overlook, night. After a dangerous joint expedition]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: That was INSANE. That ceiling almost crushed us both. You okay?

options.text: I'm okay. You saved my life back there.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I... yeah. I guess I did.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Jack, can I say something weird?

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I've explored every ruin within fifty miles. I'm not scared of anything.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Except this. Right now. This is the scariest thing I've ever done.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I've been running toward danger my whole life because it's easier than standing still.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: But you — you make me want to come HOME.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Not just survive out there. Come home. To someone.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: So. There it is. The great explorer, terrified of three stupid words.

options.text: I feel the same way, Leera.
You don't have to say them. I already know.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Oh thank god. I was going to DIE if you said 'let's just be friends.'

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Good. Now look at those stars. Because I am NOT looking at you right now.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: My face is doing something embarrassing.
